diabetes_treatment.text: diabetes treatment: Type 2 Diabetes: Currently on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Doctor suggested adding semaglutide (Ozempic) at a low dose to improve blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically ranges between 125-130 mg/dL.

hypertension_treatment.text: hypertension treatment: High Blood Pressure: Currently on losartan 50 mg once daily. Blood pressure range: 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking a daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.

hypothyroidism_treatment.text: hypothyroidism treatment: Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily. Taken on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH result: 2.1 mIU/L (within normal range). No dosage changes needed. Noticeable sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.

osteoarthritis_treatment.text: osteoarthritis treatment: Osteoarthritis: Uses acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Takes meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints are particularly stiff (knees and hands), but only as needed due to concern about NSAID overuse. Doctor recommended glucosamine supplements; effect on symptoms is uncertain and not yet confirmed.

cholesterol_management.text: cholesterol management: Statin therapy: Atorvastatin 10 mg daily. Started due to LDL of 130 mg/dL and triglycerides of 140 mg/dL. Cholesterol levels improving; no side effects reported (e.g., muscle aches). Doctor confirms this low-dose regimen is effective and well-tolerated.

medication_interactions_precautions.text: medication interactions precautions: Avoid frequent NSAID use (e.g., meloxicam) with losartan due to kidney risk. Take levothyroxine separately from calcium/iron to prevent absorption issues. Combine supplements with meals when possible.
